lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the pectoral fin, forming identifiable vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, effectively creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes along the flank structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of smaller, high-luminance spots that are notably more concentrated and irregularly sized compared to the primary flank grid.
